tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App ground: board, header, status bar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, reader page, editor, inputs, buttons.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for buttons, crumbs and menu rows.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inline code, empty-column well, editor gutter.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders, dividers, header and status bar rules. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Every control edge: input, button, checkbox, kbd. 3.2:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-hover, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Card summaries, path, counts, status bar text. At least 6.4:1 on all surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, separators, empty-state text. At least 4.5:1 on all surfaces; never smaller than 11px.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Selection, primary button fill, links, focus ring.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected card fill, text selection, active crumb.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring on every focusable element.

tokens.name: status-todo
tokens.usage: Todo column marker and label. Always shown with the word Todo.

tokens.name: status-ready
tokens.usage: Ready column marker: refined issues queued for an agent to take.

tokens.name: status-doing
tokens.usage: Doing column marker; unsaved-changes pill in the editor.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Done column marker; Saved pill; Pass verdict in a review.

tokens.name: review
tokens.usage: Violet. The AI review button and the Challenge verdict. Reserved: nothing else uses this hue. Kept clearly apart from the blue accent and from danger red.

tokens.name: review-soft
tokens.usage: Review panel header fill and the pending-review card flag.

tokens.name: on-review
tokens.usage: Text on a review fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Write failures, conflicting file on disk, Block verdict.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Delete drop zone when a card is over it. danger text reads 5.7:1 on it.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on the danger-filled Delete button in the confirmation dialog.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the board behind a modal confirmation.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: Project name in the header; reader h2.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.usage: Default UI text, inputs, card titles (at 500).

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.sample: AI assist to refine an issue
styles.usage: Card title, current crumb, button labels at 12px.

styles.name: ui-small
styles.sample: Challenge an issue before anyone picks it up

styles.name: read-h1
styles.sample: AI assist to refine an issue

styles.name: read-body
styles.sample: Challenge an issue before anyone picks it up, so a human or an AI can implement it without guessing.
styles.usage: Rendered markdown paragraphs and lists, max 68ch.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Counts, file names, kbd hints, status bar.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label nudges, kbd padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a card between title and summary.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and between header controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card horizontal padding, review row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Window gutter, column gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Reader page vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Reader page horizontal padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, kbd, crumbs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, reader page, editor, review panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: 18px-tall pills (Saved, Unsaved, verdicts).

size.note: Fixed control heights, in points. Compact but at least 22pt to stay clickable on a trackpad.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, filter input, checkbox row.

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: Header bar.

tokens.name: statusbar-h
tokens.usage: Bottom status bar.

tokens.name: column-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest column before the board scrolls horizontally.

tokens.name: column-max
tokens.usage: Widest column; extra width stays empty on the right.

tokens.name: reader-max
tokens.usage: Reader and editor page width.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Review panel and menus only. Cards stay flat.
